pta_subcommittee_for_the_winter_fair.name: PTA Subcommittee for the Winter Fair

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: The subcommittee is responsible for organizing the winter fair and needs to recruit four stall coordinators. It has an upcoming planning meeting in October. It has not yet recruited any stall coordinators as of the start time.

The PTA subcommittee for the winter fair is seeking four stall coordinators. The subcommittee's October planning meeting is scheduled to occur before the hard cutoff. The subcommittee can recruit coordinators through its own efforts or through outreach to potential volunteers.
